h1: Realme Buds 2 Wired Earphones with 11.2mm Bass Boost Drivers and Mic (Black)
short_description: Overview: Realme Buds 2 are wired in-ear earphones designed for everyday music, calls and media playback on devices with a 3.5 mm audio jack. They combine an 11.2 mm bass boost driver with a comfortable in-ear fit and practical cable design for daily use.
description:
Overview: Realme Buds 2 are wired in-ear earphones designed for everyday music, calls and media playback on devices with a 3.5 mm audio jack. They combine an 11.2 mm bass boost driver with a comfortable in-ear fit and practical cable design for daily use.

Sound & Drivers: The 11.2 mm driver is tuned to deliver enhanced bass along with clear mids for a more engaging sound on music and video content. This makes the earphones suitable for listeners who enjoy a stronger low-end response in their audio.

Design & Comfort: Soft ear tips and a lightweight build help the earphones sit securely in the ears during commutes, work or casual use. Magnetic earbuds allow you to snap the earpieces together when not in use to help reduce tangling.

Controls & Calls: A 3-button in-line remote with microphone lets you adjust volume, control playback, answer or end calls and access supported voice assistants on compatible phones.

Cable & Connectivity: The tangle-resistant braided cable and 3.5 mm connector are designed for durability and wide compatibility with many smartphones, tablets, laptops and other devices that still support a wired audio jack.
